sources_considered.why: Readable primary announcement showing a SaaS vendor commercializing a new AI offering.
Readable primary announcement showing a consumer operating-system route to AI adoption outside the proposed enterprise purchasing mechanism.
The required reader returned only a heading and date; the investor-relations copy supplied the substantive text.
Its interviews do not measure the dominant cause of industry-wide AI commitment, and an exact publication date was not verified.

evidence_items.explanation: Salesforce was offering a new paid AI product, consistent with the proposed commercialization mechanism. Announced pricing does not establish why the product was developed or how strongly that motive drove the wider industry.

Apple's announced consumer operating-system integration illustrates an AI strategy beyond enterprise SaaS procurement. It supplies a competing channel, not a measurement proving which driver predominated.

unresolved_gaps: No representative evidence establishes SaaS vendors' need for new products as the predominant industry-wide cause.
Product announcements do not distinguish growth pressure from customer demand, technical opportunity or competitive pressure.
The contribution of annual bulk purchasing by non-users is not measured.
